entries.subject: DAMIT 3217: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-3217.txt. Model 3217, version 2019-05-07, pole (250°, 43°), period 11.11129 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 93.93 ± 0.94 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 206 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.

entries.subject: Hersilia whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 19 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.940 at 462 nm, 1.013 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#444341 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 5.7% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.6%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
